items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: And that was the first time that I ever played with Dick Mackey.

ctx.x: I know him. Would come over and play jobs with us all the way from New Orleans. Well, it only cost you about $1.35 to come from New Orleans to Long Beach or Gulfport on a train. And that was the first time that I ever played with Dick Mackey. I played drums in that band. The first time I ever played with Tony Almerico was at the Dog Track in Biloxi. That was 1923. And I played drums in that band.
My goodness. Was Dick Mackey a good corner player there?
